# Security Policy

Do not report credentials, unsafe robot-control behavior, or other security-sensitive issues in a
public issue. Send a minimal private report to `xuhao3e8@gmail.com` and
`shuo.yang@mondorobotics.com`.

This repository generates motion references; it is not a certified safety controller. Validate
joint ordering, limits, collision behavior, and emergency-stop operation in simulation before any
hardware deployment.
